title: She Will Be Loved

cues.en: Beauty queen of only 18 she had some trouble with herself
cues.zh: 年僅18歲的選美皇后她自己也遇到了一些麻煩
cues.text: Beauty queen of only 18 she had some trouble with herself

cues.en: She was always there to help her she always belonged to someone else
cues.zh: 她總是在那裡幫助她，她總是屬於別人
cues.text: She was always there to help her she always belonged to someone else

cues.en: I drove for miles and miles and wound up at your door
cues.zh: 我開了好幾英里終於到了你家門口
cues.text: I drove for miles and miles and wound up at your door

cues.en: I've had you so many times but somehow I want more
cues.zh: 我已經擁有你很多次了，但不知何故我想要更多
cues.text: I've had you so many times but somehow I want more

cues.en: I don't mind spending every day on your corner in the pouring rain
cues.zh: 我不介意每天在傾盆大雨中在你的角落度過
cues.text: I don't mind spending every day on your corner in the pouring rain

cues.en: Look for the girl with the broken smile As good as she wants to stay alive
cues.zh: 尋找那個笑容破碎的女孩 儘管她想活下去
cues.text: Look for the girl with the broken smile As good as she wants to stay alive

cues.en: And she will be loved And she will be loved
cues.zh: 她會被愛 她會被愛
cues.text: And she will be loved And she will be loved

cues.en: I know I tend to get so insecure Doesn't matter anymore
cues.zh: 我知道我變得如此缺乏安全感不再重要了
cues.text: I know I tend to get so insecure Doesn't matter anymore

cues.en: It's not always rainbows and butterflies It's compromised it moves us alone
cues.zh: 它並不總是彩虹和蝴蝶它妥協了它讓我們獨自感動
cues.text: It's not always rainbows and butterflies It's compromised it moves us alone

cues.en: Yeah, my heart is full and my door's always open

cues.en: Know all of the things that make you who you are
